chapter_title.ar: باب الْفَيْ‏ءِ وَ الْأَنْفَالِ وَ تَفْسِيرِ الْخُمُسِ وَ حُدُودِهِ وَ مَا يَجِبُ فِيهِ
chapter_title.en: Chapter 130 – Al-Fey (Military gains) and Al-Anfal (Non-military gains) and the interpretation of Al-Khums (A fifth of military gains) and its limits and what it is Obligated upon

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (267/ 6)

translations.bn: আমাদের কয়েকজন সঙ্গী আহমদ ইবন মুহাম্মদ থেকে, তিনি আলী ইবন আল-হাকাম থেকে, তিনি আলী ইবন আবি হামযা থেকে, তিনি মুহাম্মদ ইবন মুসলিম থেকে বর্ণনা করেছেন, যিনি বলেছেন:
translations.de: Eine Anzahl unserer Gefährten überlieferte von Ahmad ibn Muhammad, von ʿAli ibn al-Ḥakam, von ʿAli ibn Abī Ḥamzah, von Muhammad ibn Muslim, der sagte:
translations.en: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
translations.es: Un grupo de nuestros compañeros, de Ahmad ibn Muhammad, de ʿAli ibn al-Ḥakam, de ʿAli ibn Abī Ḥamzah, de Muhammad ibn Muslim, quien dijo:
translations.fa: تعدادی از یاران ما، از احمد بن محمد، از علی بن الحکم، از علی بن ابی حمزه، از محمد بن مسلم روایت کردند که گفت:
translations.fr: Un certain nombre de nos compagnons, d’après Ahmad ibn Muhammad, d’après ʿAli ibn al-Ḥakam, d’après ʿAli ibn Abī Ḥamzah, d’après Muhammad ibn Muslim, qui a dit :
translations.id: Sejumlah sahabat kami, dari Ahmad ibn Muhammad, dari ʿAli ibn al-Ḥakam, dari ʿAli ibn Abī Ḥamzah, dari Muhammad ibn Muslim, yang berkata:
translations.ru: Некоторые из наших сподвижников передали от Ахмада ибн Мухаммада, от ʿАли ибн аль-Хакама, от ʿАли ибн Аби Хамзы, от Мухаммада ибн Муслима, который сказал:
translations.tr: Ashabımızdan bir grup, Ahmed ibn Muhammed’den, o Ali ibn el-Hakem’den, o Ali ibn Ebi Hamza’dan, o Muhammed ibn Müslim’den rivayet etti; o şöyle dedi:
translations.ur: ہمارے چند اصحاب نے، احمد بن محمد سے، وہ علی بن الحکم سے، وہ علی بن ابی حمزہ سے، وہ محمد بن مسلم سے روایت کی، جنہوں نے کہا:
translations.zh: 我们的一些同伴传述自AhmadibnMuhammad，传自ʿAliibnal-Ḥakam，传自ʿAliibnAbīḤamzah，传自MuhammadibnMuslim，他说：

translations.bn: আমি আবু জাফর عليه السلام-কে বলতে শুনেছি:
translations.de: Ich hörte Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام sagen:
translations.en: I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying:
translations.es: Escuché a Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام decir:
translations.fa: از ابوجعفر علیه السلام شنیدم که می‌فرمود:
translations.fr: J’ai entendu Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام dire :
translations.id: Aku mendengar Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام bersabda:
translations.ru: Я слышал, как Абу Джаʿфар عليه السلام говорил:
translations.tr: Ebû Caʿfer عليه السلام’ın şöyle dediğini işittim:
translations.ur: میں نے ابو جعفر علیہ السلام کو یہ فرماتے ہوئے سنا:

translations.bn: আর সূরা আল-আনফালে নাক কেটে ফেলার কথা আছে।
translations.de: Und in Sūrat al-Anfāl gibt es das Abschneiden der Nase.
translations.en: And in Sūrat al-Anfāl there is cutting off the nose.
translations.es: Y en Sūrat al-Anfāl hay cortar la nariz.
translations.fa: و در سورهٔ الأنفال بریدن بینی است.
translations.fr: Et dans Sūrat al-Anfāl, il y a la coupure du nez.
translations.id: Dan dalam Sūrat al-Anfāl terdapat pemotongan hidung.
translations.ru: И в суре Аль-Анфаль есть отсечение носа.
translations.ur: اور سورۂ الأنفال میں ناک کا کاٹ دینا ہے۔

en.النَّفْلُ: That which is additional or extra; the term used here to explain al-Anfāl.
en.الْأَنْفَالُ: The spoils or surplus gains discussed in the hadith and chapter context.
en.جَدْعُ الْأَنْفِ: Literally, cutting off the nose; an Arabic expression used in the hadith.
en.سُورَةِ الْأَنْفَالِ: Sūrat al-Anfāl, the Quranic chapter mentioned in the report.

seo_questions.bn: আবু জাফর عليه السلام-এর হাদিসে আল-আনফালের অর্থ সম্পর্কে কী বলা হয়েছে?
seo_questions.de: Was sagt der Hadith von Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام über die Bedeutung von al-Anfāl?
seo_questions.en: What does the hadith of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام say about the meaning of al-Anfāl?
seo_questions.es: ¿Qué dice el hadiz de Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام sobre el significado de al-Anfāl?
seo_questions.fa: حدیث ابوجعفر علیه السلام دربارهٔ معنای الأنفال چه می‌گوید؟
seo_questions.fr: Que dit le hadith d’Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام au sujet du sens de al-Anfāl ?
seo_questions.id: Apa yang dikatakan hadis Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام tentang makna al-Anfāl?
seo_questions.ru: Что говорит хадис Абу Джаʿфара عليه السلام о значении аль-Анфаль?
seo_questions.tr: Ebû Caʿfer عليه السلام’ın hadisine göre el-Enfâl’in anlamı nedir?
seo_questions.ur: ابو جعفر علیہ السلام کی حدیث میں الأنفال کے معنی کے بارے میں کیا کہا گیا ہے؟
seo_questions.zh: AbūJaʿfar عليه السلام的圣训是如何说明al-Anfāl的含义的？

summaries.bn: এই হাদিসে আল-আনফাল শব্দটির সংক্ষিপ্ত ব্যাখ্যা দেওয়া হয়েছে এবং তা সূরা আল-আনফালের শব্দচয়ন ও অর্থের সঙ্গে যুক্ত করা হয়েছে। এটি শিয়া হাদিস সাহিত্যে আল-ফাই’, আল-আনফাল এবং খুমস সম্পর্কে বৃহত্তর আলোচনার মধ্যে আবু জাফর عليه السلام-এর একটি তাফসিরমূলক বক্তব্যকে প্রতিফলিত করে।
summaries.de: Dieser Hadith bietet eine kurze Erklärung des Begriffs al-Anfāl und verknüpft ihn mit der Formulierung und Bedeutung von Sūrat al-Anfāl. Er spiegelt eine auslegende Aussage von Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام im weiteren Zusammenhang der Diskussion über al-fayʾ, al-anfāl und khums in der schiitischen Hadith-Literatur wider.
summaries.en: This hadith presents a brief explanation of the term al-Anfāl and links it to the wording and meaning associated with Sūrat al-Anfāl. It reflects an interpretive statement by Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام within the broader discussion of al-fayʾ, al-anfāl, and khums in Shia hadith literature.
summaries.es: Este hadiz presenta una breve explicación del término al-Anfāl y lo vincula con la expresión y el significado asociados con Sūrat al-Anfāl. Refleja una declaración interpretativa de Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام dentro de la discusión más amplia sobre al-fayʾ, al-anfāl y el khums en la literatura hadiz chií.
summaries.fa: این حدیث توضیحی کوتاه دربارهٔ اصطلاح الأنفال ارائه می‌دهد و آن را به تعبیر و معنای مرتبط با سورهٔ الأنفال پیوند می‌زند. این سخنی تفسیری از ابوجعفر علیه السلام در چارچوب بحث گسترده‌تر دربارهٔ الفیء، الأنفال و خمس در حدیث شیعه است.
summaries.fr: Ce hadith présente une brève explication du terme al-Anfāl et le relie à la formulation et au sens associés à Sūrat al-Anfāl. Il reflète une déclaration interprétative d’Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام dans le cadre plus large de la discussion sur al-fayʾ, al-anfāl et le khums dans la littérature hadith chiite.
summaries.id: Hadis ini memberikan penjelasan singkat tentang istilah al-Anfāl dan mengaitkannya dengan redaksi serta makna yang terkait dengan Sūrat al-Anfāl. Ini mencerminkan pernyataan tafsir dari Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام dalam pembahasan yang lebih luas tentang al-fayʾ, al-anfāl, dan khums dalam literatur hadis Syiah.
summaries.ru: Этот хадис кратко разъясняет термин аль-Анфаль и связывает его с формулировкой и смыслом, относящимися к суре Аль-Анфаль. Он отражает толковательное высказывание Абу Джаʿфара عليه السلام в более широком обсуждении аль-файʾ, аль-анфаль и хумса в шиитской хадисной литературе.
summaries.tr: Bu hadis, el-Enfâl teriminin kısa bir açıklamasını sunar ve onu Sûretü’l-Enfâl’deki ifade ve anlamla ilişkilendirir. Şiî hadis literatüründe el-feyʾ, el-anfâl ve humus hakkındaki daha geniş tartışma içinde Ebû Caʿfer عليه السلام’a ait bir tefsir ifadesini yansıtır.
summaries.ur: یہ حدیث لفظ الأنفال کی مختصر وضاحت پیش کرتی ہے اور اسے سورۂ الأنفال کے الفاظ اور معنی سے جوڑتی ہے۔ یہ ابو جعفر علیہ السلام کی ایک تفسیری بات ہے جو شیعہ حدیثی ادب میں الفیء، الأنفال اور خمس کے وسیع تر مباحث کے ضمن میں آتی ہے۔
summaries.zh: 这段圣训简要解释了al-Anfāl一词，并将其与Sūratal-Anfāl相关的措辞和含义联系起来。它反映了AbūJaʿfar عليه السلام在什叶派圣训文献中关于al-fayʾ、al-anfāl和khums的更广泛讨论中的一种诠释性表述。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (267/ 6)
text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ الْأَنْفَالُ هُوَ النَّفْلُ وَ فِي سُورَةِ الْأَنْفَالِ جَدْعُ الْأَنْفِ .

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Al-Anfal, it is the voluntary act, and in Surah Al-Anfal (Chapter 8) is an amputation of the nose (breaking the pride of the enemies of the Ahl Al-Bayt<sup>asws</sup>)’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah has narrated from Certain persons of our people that I thinks is al-Sayyari from Ali ibn Asbat who has said the following. “In one of the meetings of abu al-Hassan Musa (a.s.) with al-Mahdi (one of ‘Abbassid ruler) the Imam found him paying reparations (for the damages caused to people). The Imam (a.s.) said, “O Amir al-Mu’minin, what has happened to the reparations due to us?” He then asked, “What damage is caused to you O abu al-Hassan ?” He (the Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah, the Holy, the Most High, granted victory to His Holy Prophet (s.a) and the land of Fadak and its surrounding areas came under his control without any armed struggle Allah sent a message to His the Holy Prophet (s.a). It said, “Give the relatives their rights.” The Messenger of Allah did not know who they were. He turned to Jibril to find out and Jibril turned to his Lord for the answer. Allah then sent revelation to him to give possession of Fadak to Fatima (a.s.). Thereupon, the Messenger of Allah called Fatima and said to her. “O Fatima (a.s.) Allah has commanded me to give possession of Fadak to you. She then said, “ O the Messenger of Allah, I have accepted the offer from Allah and from you.” Thereafter her representatives lived there during the life time of the Messenger of Allah. When abu Bakr took control he expelled her representatives therefrom. She went to abu Bakr and asked him to reverse his decision and return Fadak to her but he said to Fatima (a.s.), “Bring to a black or white to testify that Fadak belonged to you.” Fatima (a.s.) brought Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) and ’Umm Ayman who both testified in favor of Fatima (a.s.). He then wrote, “Fatima must not be disturbed in the matters of Fadak.” Fatima then left with the document. On the way ‘Umar came from the opposite direction and asked, “What is it in your hand O daughter of Muhammad?” Fatima (a.s.) said, “It is a document that ibn abu Quhafa has written for me.” He said, “Show it to me.” Fatima refused to hand it over to him but he snatched it away from her hand and read it. He then spit on it wiped out its writing and tore it into pieces. He said, “This was not captured by forces of the camels and horses of your father so that you can tie the rope around our necks.” Al-Mahdi said, “O abu al-Hassan define for me the boundaries of Fadak.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “On one side it borders the mountain of ’Uhud. On the other side is ‘Arish Misr. Also it borders Sayf al-Bahr and on one of its sides is Dawmat al-Jandal.” Then he asked the Imams, “Is that all?” He said, “Yes, O Amir al-Mu’minin, this is all that came to the Messenger of Allah without the use of the forces of the camels and horses.” He said, “This is a large area but I will look into it.”
